svg.title: Designed variation CL-03
svg.desc: अस्-अन्त words | Relation: Reanalysis across classes | वैदिक: contracts -असम् / -असस् to -आम् / -आस् in several cases; these contractions | also produce parallel आकारान्त word forms | लौकिक: preserves the regular अस्-अन्त pattern or treats the resulting आकारान्त | word as a separate lexical form | Qualification: RECURRING · 4 source examples | Contribution: open · Evidence: form recorded · question open | Prevalence: 4 forms · grade B
